review.scope: pure all-day calendar arithmetic and explicit date normalization; no persistence/wiring/activation
focus: immutable ordinal anchor preserves cadence after clamp/skip
accepted UTC instant converted to named timezone for completion base
local-day DST/skipped dates, finite expansion, no ambient clock
explicit dates sorted/deduplicated after bounded validation without mutation
cold import no storage/network; mandatory suite omissions fail gate
remaining: timed recurrence and DST wall-time policy
series/occurrence persistence, range previews, count/end/missed policies
skip/edit/rotation/durable materialization and completion writer cutover
